Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` and `countBy` use a direct own-property check instead of `_.has`, which treats array keys as deep property paths.

This restores grouping by array-valued properties, where arrays are coerced to keys such as `"1,2"`.

- The single remaining failure, `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`, is pre-existing according to the canonical test runner

Fixed the `groupBy` regression in `underscore.js`.

- `groupBy` now checks keys with `hasOwnProperty.call` instead of `_.has`.
- This prevents array-valued keys from being interpreted as deep property paths.
- The reported case now groups both items into one bucket.

- No test files were modified.
